title: Spence is called up by England, Bisseck makes UEFA's XI
description: Yann Bisseck is in UEFA's Champions League team of the week, and Inter host Como on Sunday in the last match before the international break.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 66, Friday, November 6, 2026 — Spence is called up by England, Bisseck makes UEFA's XI

blocks.html: Inter host Como at San Siro on Sunday, second against fourth and the last match before the break. Djed Spence, Inter's England defender, is in the 25-man squad England named on Friday for Croatia and Spain. UEFA picked Yann Bisseck, Inter's center-back, for its Champions League team of the week, alongside the Como striker he will face on Sunday.

blocks.h3: England call Spence up for Croatia and Spain
paras: Djed Spence, Inter's England defender, is in the 25-man squad the Football Association named on Friday. England play Croatia at Wembley and then Spain in Madrid. The announcement says Spence returns after missing the last camp with an injury.
He is the only player in the squad who plays for an Italian club.

blocks.h3: UEFA name Bisseck in the team of the week
paras: Yann Bisseck, Inter's center-back, is one of eleven players UEFA's Technical Observer Group chose from Champions League Matchday 4. UEFA credited his first goal in the competition, the opener at Feyenoord, and a defensive performance that helped Inter keep a clean sheet.
Tasos Douvikas, the Como striker Inter face on Sunday, is in the same eleven.

blocks.h3: Inter appoint a director of football development
paras: Simone Lo Schiavo joined Inter on Thursday as Director of Football Development, reporting to Dario Baccin, the club's chief football officer. He started at Vibonese, was head of scouting and then youth technical coordinator at Roma, ran scouting at Salernitana, and most recently worked in Palermo's scouting department.

Giuseppe Marotta, Inter's president and chief executive, said Lo Schiavo brings "valuable expertise and great enthusiasm" to the club. Marotta added that he will play an important role in the daily work of the football department.

blocks.h3: Sky Sport Italia expects Esposito to start next to Thuram
paras: Sky Sport Italia's page for Sunday has Cristian Chivu, Inter's head coach, playing a 3-5-2 with two forwards, Francesco Pio Esposito and Marcus Thuram. Djed Spence and Federico Dimarco are the wing-backs.

The same page marks Lautaro Martínez, Inter's captain, and Luis Henrique, a winger, as unavailable. Curtis Jones, a midfielder, and John Stones, a defender, are listed as doubts and named among the substitutes.

blocks.h3: Corriere dello Sport counts 20 goals in six meetings
paras: Inter and Como have scored 20 goals between them across their last six meetings, an average of 3.33 a match, Corriere dello Sport reports. Inter won five of those six and drew the other.
In each of the last two, a 4–3 in Serie A and a 3–2 in the Coppa Italia semifinal, Inter came back from two goals down.
